newsitem.title: ITALY: TENNIS-CHAMPION MUSTER KNOCKED OUT OF ITALIAN OPEN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-CHAMPION MUSTER KNOCKED OUT OF ITALIAN OPEN.

text.p: Defending champion Thomas Muster saw his dream of a third consecutive Italian Open title dashed by Australian Scott Draper in the second round on Wednesday.
The tough Austrian, unbeaten at the Foro Italico since losing in the third round in 1994, went down 7-6 5-7 7-5 to join the tournament's growing list of big-name casualties.
The world's top two players, Americans Pete Sampras and Michael Chang, seeded one and two, lost in the first round to Jim Courier and Argentine Gumy Hernan respectively on Tuesday.

Unseeded Draper, who has reached the fourth round of the French Open for the past two years, eliminated Hamburg Open winner Andrei Medvedev in the first round but had never previously beaten a top 10 player.
